external_entities.description: An administrator connecting to the MySQL database.

processes.name: Web server (CMS)

data_stores.description: A MySQL database containing pages, accounts, and comments.

data_stores.description: A bucket used for images, stylesheets, downloads, and new assets.

data_flows.name: page requests (HTTPS)
data_flows.description: Page requests from the reader to the web server.

data_flows.name: pages, accounts, comments
data_flows.description: Pages, accounts, and comments sent from the web server to the database.

data_flows.description: Images, stylesheets, and downloads requested by the reader from the CDN bucket.

trust_boundaries.description: The hosted network containing the web server and MySQL database.

assumptions.assumption: Reader is a human external entity.
assumptions.basis: The node is named 'Reader' and is shown as an actor initiating page requests and downloads.

assumptions.assumption: Admin is a human external entity.
assumptions.basis: The node is named 'Admin' and is shown as an actor initiating a MySQL connection.

assumptions.assumption: The Web server (CMS) presents a web interface.
assumptions.basis: It is named a web server and receives page requests.

assumptions.assumption: The web server and database are in the Hosted network boundary.
assumptions.basis: The web node is inside the 'Hosted network' subgraph.

assumptions.assumption: The MySQL database is in the Hosted network boundary.
assumptions.basis: The database node is inside the 'Hosted network' subgraph.

assumptions.assumption: The database and web server hold or handle personally identifying information.
assumptions.basis: The database is described as containing 'accounts' and 'comments'.

assumptions.assumption: The web server handles personally identifying information.
assumptions.basis: The web server sends and receives data described as 'accounts' and 'comments'.
The database contains accounts and comments, which are records about or attributable to people.

assumptions.assumption: The pages, accounts, and comments flow carries personally identifying information.
assumptions.basis: The flow is explicitly labelled 'pages, accounts, comments'.
